name: page-diagonal-wipe
title: Page Diagonal Wipe
description: A 45-degree angled clip-path diagonal wipe sweeping across the screen boundary on section change.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Angled Mask Reveal: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
